title: pseudocymopterus beckii
intro: Pseudocymopterus beckii, commonly known as Rocky Mountain carrot, is a perennial plant native to the western United States. It belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae) and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pseudocymopterus beckii include its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
